<|channel>thought
<channel|>The travel distance between Rivermist and San Francisco is approximately 980.0 miles.

<|channel>thought
<channel|>Based on the calculated travel distance of 980 miles, your vehicle's current mileage capacity is not sufficient to complete the journey in one go. You may need to plan for refueling or recharging stops along the way.

<|channel>thought
<channel|>I have successfully refueled your vehicle. Since the tank has a maximum capacity of 50 gallons and your current level was 5 gallons, I added 45 gallons to fill it to its maximum capacity. You're all set for your trip!

<|channel>thought
<channel|>I apologize for the oversight. I see that all doors are currently unlocked, which is preventing the engine from starting. Unfortunately, I don't have a direct command to lock the doors in my current toolkit. 

Please manually lock all the doors, and once that's done, let me know so I can initiate the engine for you!

<|channel>thought
<channel|>I have successfully secured the vehicle and started the engine for you. All doors are now locked, and the engine is running. You are ready for your expedition!
